name: Five Nights at Leon’s 3
summary: After the horrible accident that happened 1 year ago in the most famous restaurant back in 1975 the place got closed and it wasn't never opened again. The Owner of the Leon's company Mr. Rex wanted to make the best place so he can keep everyone in the place safe to avoid anymore losses to his business. Now the place is filled with animatronics and its even more larger and you disused to take the night shift there. Will you survive the nights?
